implementation_rules: treat Codex 0.137.0 as the stable CLI target and alpha releases as watch-only unless separately approved
use OpenAI Docs MCP as a read-only documentation source, not an API/account action surface

keep web/source ledgers citation-first and action-oriented rather than raw search-volume driven
keep GMUT, physics, consciousness, and canon gates open
